#!/bin/bash
# What step 1 is worth inside the batches (bench-report.md of
# feat/posting-edge-index, 2026-11-27): step 3 as it is (s3), with the plans
# as before step 1 (s3n) and with the plan of a caller alone keeping its
# budget (s3a), in turn, at 100k with 1 and 8 callers, two passes. Nothing
# here builds.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
R=$S/r100
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/dbpedia-openai-1000k-angular.bin
COMMON="-bench.dataset $D -bench.limit 100000 -bench.queries 1000 -test.v -test.timeout 0"
integ() { # binary-name callers pass
  local b=$1 c=$2 p=$3 dir=$R/runs-variants/$1-c$2-p$3
  mkdir -p $dir/index
  date "+== %H:%M:%S $b callers $c pass $p"
  (cd $R/$b/adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge && PE_RUSAGE=$dir/rusage.json $R/$b-w.test \
    -test.run '^(TestIntegrationScale|TestZZWritten)$' $COMMON \
    -bench.integrationdir $dir/index -bench.integrationout $dir/result.json -bench.integrationbase 10000 \
    -bench.integrationwriters $c -bench.integrationcycles -bench.integrationdelete 0 -bench.integrationreopen=false \
    -bench.integrationefs 40,160 > $dir/run.log 2>&1)
  echo "$b c$c p$p exit $?"
  find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/r100/runs-variants -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
}
for p in 1 2; do
  for c in 1 8; do
    for b in s3 s3n s3a; do
      integ $b $c $p
    done
  done
done
date "+== %H:%M:%S done"
